brief: Asymmetrical comic impact frame: unequal broad tips, irregular gaps, different top/bottom and left/right contours. Current display size and motion preserved.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent PNG damage-number impact frame for a hand-drawn business card game.
Primary request: Create a NEW distinctly ASYMMETRICAL comic impact bubble. The previous frame in the reference is too symmetric. Use it only for the cream paper, black brush ink, ochre and brick-red palette; completely redesign its silhouette.
Composition: approximately 1.6:1 width to height, full and plump, sparse large tips with irregular spacing. A hand-drawn, lopsided explosion: one dominant broad spike projects toward upper left, a longer narrow spike projects near lower right, a shallow curved shoulder at upper right, a blunt short notch along left bottom. Other broad points vary strongly in length, width and lean. The top and bottom contours must clearly differ; the left and right contours must clearly differ. About 9 to 11 broad points total, no small serrations. No tip directly opposite a matching tip. No cardinal-axis star pattern. No rotational or mirror symmetry. Do NOT put a spike at each of the four cardinal directions.
Keep a large clean light ivory center centered in the image for the game's dynamic damage numbers, with comfortable empty space. Full frame fits inside transparent padding.
Style: lively hand-inked European vintage comic, chunky imperfect black brush outline, modest red and ochre accents on a few nonmatching edges, subtle cream paper texture inside. Deliberate irregular hand-drawn energy, not a geometric star or logo.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background outside; no text, numbers, lettering, watermark, shadows, speed rays, extra debris or halftone clouds. Keep large readable sparse shapes. This must visibly look irregular and unbalanced in its edge rhythm while the clear number area stays centered.

rendering.outlineGeometry: Original PNG outer alpha contour, 119 points
rendering.launch: Victim center, grow over 0.42s, rise 268 units over 0.55s, drift 18 units, fade 0.9-1.3s
